title: A Digital Anthology of Early Modern English Drama (EMED), Folger Shakespeare Library
notes:
Corpus of 403 plays first professionally performed in London 1576-1642 and printed before 1660 (count per EMED/Folgerpedia documentation): 343 plays transcribed from EEBO-TCP texts (via Martin Mueller's Shakespeare His Contemporaries corpus) plus about 30 consistently encoded in TEI P5 as documentary editions; TEI XML files downloadable from the project data page. Coverage of full TEI encoding is partial, so the 403 count covers the whole corpus, not only the TEI-encoded subset. First-publication year not verified; project documentation consulted 2026.

Justification: A freely accessible TEI digital anthology of early modern English drama with downloadable XML, within 1450-1700 and not in the catalogue (EEBO-TCP and the Folger Shakespeare are catalogued separately). Found via Folgerpedia's listing of early modern drama projects and the EMED data page.
Found at: https://folgerpedia.folger.edu/A_Digital_Anthology_of_Early_Modern_English_Drama
